environment.description: Same application deployed on Tomcat 9.0.68. Database connectivity is mediated through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction-pooling mode with a custom query parser module. The PgBouncer instance is compiled with the pgbouncer-rr patch (query routing/rewriting extension) configured with a Lua script that enforces a statement whitelist: only single SELECT statements are permitted through the pooler, and any query containing UNION, semicolons outside string literals, or subqueries referencing pg_catalog/information_schema is terminated with an error before reaching PostgreSQL. Additionally, the PostgreSQL role used by PgBouncer has column-level SELECT privileges only on (summary, created_date, detail_blob, internal_notes) in report_details and (title, owner, department, report_id) in reports — no table-wide SELECT grant. The Lua validation script SHA256 is pinned in the PgBouncer config and loaded from a read-only ConfigMap mount.

config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass, no request-level filtering
config.pgbouncer_patch: pgbouncer-rr with Lua query validation script
config.lua_script_policy: REJECT if query matches: multiple statements (;), UNION keyword outside quotes, references to pg_catalog.* or information_schema.*, COPY/EXECUTE/PREPARE statements. Only single SELECT allowed.
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT (summary, created_date, detail_blob, internal_notes) ON report_details TO pgbouncer_user; GRANT SELECT (title, owner, department, report_id) ON reports TO pgbouncer_user;
